candidates.decision_relevance: Would show whether price and relative-performance changes preceded or followed deterioration, rebounds, and weekly endpoints, reducing sequence and hindsight uncertainty across the reviewed periods.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly and daily reviews repeatedly note that price paths, indicator timestamps, and freeze-time sequences are absent or not aligned; some reviews provide only endpoint or overlapping-window summaries.
candidates.metric_name: Timestamped hourly BTC and ETH spot or mark-price series, with ETH/BTC ratio derived from same-time observations
candidates.missing_history_problem: The supplied horizon returns and occasional ETH/BTC hourly samples do not provide a continuous, consistently timestamped BTC/ETH path across the reviewed weeks for checking drawdowns, rebounds, and temporal ordering.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would make breadth changes auditable over time and distinguish broad participation from changing-universe or endpoint effects cited as counterevidence to both deterioration and rotation interpretations.
candidates.evidence_reference: Daily reviews report proxy breadth snapshots with different membership hashes and no canonical breadth history or consistent universe; weekly reviews also identify missing breadth sequences and methodology.
candidates.metric_name: Point-in-time constituent returns and membership for the breadth proxy, sufficient to derive daily advancer/decliner counts and equal-weight returns
candidates.missing_history_problem: Isolated proxy counts and mismatched snapshots cannot establish whether participation broadened or narrowed persistently, or whether apparent changes reflect membership differences.

candidates.decision_relevance: Would support retrospective comparison of the information available at each freeze with subsequent price paths, while keeping warning outcomes and nonwarning adverse excursions distinguishable and avoiding hindsight leakage.
candidates.evidence_reference: Weekly reviews report missing prospective typed warning rows, candidate-linked outcomes, and freeze-time observations; existing calibration summaries describe overlapping cohorts and do not establish independent warning outcomes.
candidates.metric_name: Freeze-timestamp-linked BTC and ETH forward return and maximum adverse/favorable excursion observations at 12h, 72h, and 168h, with original freeze-time fields
candidates.missing_history_problem: Aggregate cohort medians and source-outcome counts cannot identify what was observable at each freeze or connect a particular frozen observation to its later path; missing or untyped rows cannot be interpreted as zero outcomes.
